description: This file contains setup and drawing functions for a graphical application, including font loading, text rendering with different fonts and alignments, and drawing circles. It manages graphical elements using functions like createWindow, loadFont, background, textFont, fill, textSize, text, circle, push, pop, and textAlign, indicating it is a script for a graphical or creative coding framework.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the application window and loads three font files into variables.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Render loop that clears the background, sets fonts, colors, and sizes, and draws various text elements with different alignments and a circle, providing a demonstration of font usage and text positioning.
